text:
nina_sales: Heads-up — Acme confirmed they want Private deployment POC with PrivateLink only. They asked for a single concise onboarding doc: steps to create VPCEs, minimal SG/NACL, and routing/DNS tips. Also asked if we need TGW for metrics/ingest.

ethan_se: PrivateLink-only should cover API/control-plane traffic. TGW only required if they need route-level access into our infra VPCs or want to centralize multi-account connectivity. For most POCs, VPCEs + ENIs are enough.

sai_net: Minimal network checklist we recommend sending (short bullet list):
- Confirm VPC CIDR and ensure it does NOT overlap with our infra 10.240.0.0/16.
- Provide one private subnet ID per AZ for interface endpoint ENIs (prefer /24).
- Ensure subnets have free IPs (avoid /28).
- Create interface endpoint using svc name we provide and share VPCE id(s).

lina_sre: Security bullets to include:
- Endpoint SG: inbound TCP 443 from app subnets; inbound TCP 15001 from healthcheck subnets if used. Outbound TCP 443 to our control-plane CIDRs.
- NACLs: allow ephemeral ports 1024-65535 outbound; allow inbound 443.
- Tag VPCE/subnets with `redwood:poc=acme` so we can locate them.

ethan_se: DNS note for the doc: recommend enabling Private DNS on the VPCE if they want our hostnames to resolve to ENI IPs automatically. If they use split-horizon DNS, instruct them to add Route53 private A records pointing to ENI IPs.

sai_net: Quick CLI snippets customers can copy:

```bash
# create interface endpoint (customer account)
aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-0123abcd --vpc-endpoint-type Interface --service-name com.amazonaws.vpce.us-west-2.vpce-svc-xxxxxx --subnet-ids subnet-aaa subnet-bbb --security-group-ids sg-111

# after creation, share VPCE id (e.g., vpce-0abc1234) with us for acceptance
```

lina_sre: Troubleshooting tips to add to the one-pager:
- If curl fails with TLS/SNI errors, run curl from an EC2 inside their VPC and paste verbose output. Example: `curl -v --resolve api.redwood.internal:443:10.2.3.4 https://api.redwood.internal/health`.
- If DNS resolves to public IPs, check Private DNS flag or private hosted zone records.
- If connection intermittent, check ENI IP exhaustion in the chosen subnets.

nina_sales: Pricing Q: they asked which trial path is fastest. Short answer: Dedicated-managed reserved pool is fastest (we handle infra & TGW), Private requires infra + license and slower setup. I'll ask them preference in reply.

ethan_se: One more operational gotcha: corporate egress proxies can rewrite Host headers/SNI. Recommend they test directly from inside VPC (not through corp proxy) when debugging. Add that sentence to the doc.

sai_net: I'll draft the one-pager and paste it here. Keep it < 1 page.

infra-bot: :white_check_mark: Created POC-3122. Add VPCE IDs and subnet IDs as comments to this thread when available.

nina_sales: Perfect — send draft, I'll forward to Acme and request VPCE IDs + preferred pricing model.

ethan_se: When they share VPCE IDs we'll accept and run quick validation (DNS + curl). If they later want metrics/streaming into our infra, we'll discuss TGW attachment.

lina_sre: Also ask them to provide a brief maintenance window for acceptance testing (15-30 mins) so we can run in-session troubleshooting.

nina_sales: Will do. Sending now. :rocket:
